item.description: Upper abdominal fat or obesity refers to the accumulation of visceral fat in the upper abdominal region, leading to an increased waist size. Visceral fat is a kind of fat that lies between your abdominal walls and organs. The general factors that contribute to upper belly fat are lack of exercise, poor diet, stress and genetic predisposition to health conditions. #weightloss

item.description: Struggling with the 'mommy tummy' or diastasis recti? You're not alone! ❤️ This gentle fat loss workout is designed to help you safely heal and strengthen your core postpartum.
